notes: Design-approval resolutions of the Art Commission, 1949-1959, the years its minutes print each resolution with a 'Designer:' line. 771 resolutions extracted; 182 concern a building with a named designer; 31 curated here onto a page. Approvals of a project at several stages are reduced to the most informative one.

coverage.remaining: 1932-1948 and 1960-1983 volumes (narrative minutes without a Designer: line; read by passage). Within 1949-1959: projects outside the city (airport, Hetch Hetchy, Crystal Springs, Camp Mather, Log Cabin Ranch), engineering works, signs and marquees were skipped; A. P. Giannini (Funston and Santiago Junior High, Kump, 1953), City College (Pflueger), Brooks Hall (WBE, 1955), Candlestick (Giants Stadium, Bolles, 1958), the Ortega Branch Library (since rebuilt), the Phelan Beach and North Beach pool buildings, Portola and Funston playgrounds and the Youth Guidance Center were not placed.
coverage.note: Extraction regex in /mnt/project-files/sf-art-commission/ (ext2.py output res.json); the curated list is F.py.
